metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Brooklyn, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2). Dates: Oct 1–23 (end-exclusive as Oct 24) for years 2018, 2019, 2021. Location: Brooklyn, NY via TIGER/2018/Counties (Kings County, FIPS 36047).
2. Masking strategy: Mask low-quality pixels using qa_value ≥ 0.75 (standard for S5P NO2). No cloud masking beyond QA.
3. Logic: 
   - If any year has 0 images: C1 (try NRTI fallback first).
   - If images exist but valid pixel count after masking = 0: C2.
   - If mean is null/NaN/non-finite: C3.
   - Otherwise compare means: 2021 < 2019 and 2021 < 2018 → A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.evaluate((val, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(val);
    });
  });
}

function getBrooklynGeometry() {
  const counties = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Counties')
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('STATEFP', '36'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Kings'));
  return counties.geometry();
}

function buildNO2Collection(year, geom, collectionId) {
  return ee.ImageCollection(collectionId)
    .filterDate(`${year}-10-01`, `${year}-10-24`)
    .filterBounds(geom)
    .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']);
}

function maskNO2(img) {
  const qa = img.select('qa_value');
  const no2 = img.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density');
  const mask = qa.gte(0.75);
  return no2.updateMask(mask).rename('no2');
}

async function getPeriodMetrics(year, geom) {
  let col = buildNO2Collection(year, geom, 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2');
  let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
  if (size === 0) {
    col = buildNO2Collection(year, geom, 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2');
    size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      return { status: 'C1', year, size: 0 };
    }
  }
  const masked = col.map(maskNO2);
  const imgMean = masked.mean().rename('no2');

  const scale = 3000;
  const totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e13,
    tileScale: 2
  }).get('const');

  const validCount = imgMean.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e13,
    tileScale: 2
  }).get('no2');

  const meanVal = imgMean.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e13,
    tileScale: 2
  }).get('no2');

  const [tot, valCnt, mean] = await Promise.all([
    getInfoAsync(totalCount),
    getInfoAsync(validCount),
    getInfoAsync(meanVal)
  ]);

  if (!tot || tot === 0 || !valCnt || valCnt === 0) {
    return { status: 'C2', year, size, total: tot || 0, valid: valCnt || 0, mean: mean };
  }
  if (mean === null || Number.isNaN(mean) || !Number.isFinite(mean)) {
    return { status: 'C3', year, size, total: tot, valid: valCnt, mean: mean };
  }
  return {
    status: 'OK',
    year,
    size,
    total: tot,
    valid: valCnt,
    coverage: valCnt / tot,
    mean  // mol/m^2
  };
}

function fmtPct(x) { return (x * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'; }
function fmtMol(x) { return x.toExponential(3) + ' mol/m^2'; }

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    const geom = getBrooklynGeometry();

    const [m2018, m2019, m2021] = await Promise.all([
      getPeriodMetrics(2018, geom),
      getPeriodMetrics(2019, geom),
      getPeriodMetrics(2021, geom)
    ]);

    console.log('Region: Kings County, NY (Brooklyn)');
    const metrics = [m2018, m2019, m2021];

    // Early exits for C1/C2/C3
    if (metrics.some(m => m.status === 'C1')) {
      metrics.forEach(m => console.log(`${m.year} Images: ${m.size || 0}`));
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (metrics.some(m => m.status === 'C2')) {
      metrics.forEach(m => {
        if (m.status === 'OK') {
          console.log(`${m.year} Images: ${m.size}; Valid px: ${m.valid}/${m.total} (${fmtPct(m.coverage)}); Mean NO2: ${fmtMol(m.mean)}`);
        } else {
          console.log(`${m.year} Images: ${m.size || 0}; Valid px: ${m.valid || 0}/${m.total || 0}`);
        }
      });
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (metrics.some(m => m.status === 'C3')) {
      metrics.forEach(m => console.log(`${m.year} Images: ${m.size || 0}`));
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    metrics.forEach(m => {
      console.log(`${m.year} Images: ${m.size}; Valid px: ${m.valid}/${m.total} (${fmtPct(m.coverage)}); Mean NO2: ${fmtMol(m.mean)}`);
    });

    const v2018 = m2018.mean;
    const v2019 = m2019.mean;
    const v2021 = m2021.mean;

    const condition = (v2021 < v2019) && (v2021 < v2018);
    console.log(`Check: 2021 < 2019 (${v2021 < v2019}), 2021 < 2018 (${v2021 < v2018})`);

    console.log(condition ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
